title: Pyresias: How to write a parton shower
description: Pyresias is a tutorial parton shower in Python for final-state QCD radiation in electron-positron annihilation. It builds the Sudakov veto algorithm, angular ordering, momentum reconstruction and competition between quark and gluon branching channels in stages, from a single quark line to complete events. The repository includes a JupyterLab notebook, automated tests, the Herwig input cards used for the comparison, and the scripts and histogram data that reproduce the validation figures of the accompanying tutorial article (arXiv:2406.03528).
